symbiont-mediated suppression of host calcium or calmodulin-mediated signal transduction

definition: A process in which a symbiont interferes with, inhibits or disrupts a calcium signal transduction in the host organism. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction.
label: symbiont-mediated suppression of host calcium-mediated signal transduction
